## What Happened

In this challenge, the analyst utilized a series of tools to probe and interact with the target application, specifically focusing on HTTP and WebSocket protocols. The deep reconnaissance and path enumeration tools provided initial insights, leading to the discovery of a redirecting admin page. The successful fetching of WebSocket connections confirmed an interactive interface, allowing further command injections to bypass authentication. Moving forward, it would be beneficial to employ more exhaustive wordlists during path enumeration to discover additional endpoints and to monitor WebSocket communications more closely for session management vulnerabilities.

## Transferable Rule

Avoid this: Service may be rate-limiting or the challenge URL has changed — reduce request rate, verify URL, and try http_fetch before specialised tools

Reason: Effective use of deep reconnaissance uncovered potential authentication endpoints.
